'''Orpa Vio''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] who lived during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Orpa and her brother [[Wex Vio]] made a living as [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], operating from the [[YKL-37R Nova Courier]] ''[[Lucky Guess]]'', and on occasion they performed work on behalf of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]]. At some point shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Orpa and Wex were hired by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]] to transport some cargo to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The two smugglers traveled to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to pick up their cargo and the night before they were due to depart for Tatooine they attended a private party that Piddock was holding.<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
